videos.description: Tommy and co try to return his new baby brother to the hospital in this fun animation. With the voices of Whoopi Goldberg and Busta Rhymes. Contains flashing images.

videos.description: Dracula recruits his friends to help bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson. Animated sequel with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

videos.description: A stressed-out Dracula is whisked away on a luxury summer cruise. Animated fun with the voice of Adam Sandler.

videos.description: Pirouetting penguin Mumble is back, fighting to save his melting Antarctic home in this animation. With Elijah Wood, Brad Pitt and Matt Damon. Flashing images.

videos.description: Three singing chipmunks hit the big time in LA, but will their new-found fame and success make them forget their woodland roots? Family fun with Jason Lee and Justin Long.

videos.description: High-pitched fun as the singing rodents take on feisty female furballs The Chipettes in a Battle of the Bands contest. With Anna Faris and Justin Long.

videos.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks go overboard and are washed up on an island. Can Dave come to their rescue? Kid-friendly fun in this third big-screen adventure.

videos.description: Fearing that they might be ditched, Alvin, Simon and Theodore hit the road to prevent long-suffering guardian Dave from proposing. Comedy.

videos.title: Shrek
videos.description: Classic animated adventure with grumpy ogre Mike Myers setting out to rescue feisty princess Cameron Diaz.

videos.description: It's time for odorous ogre Mike Myers to meet the new in-laws with his princess bride Cameron Diaz. Animated antics with the voices of Antonio Banderas and Eddie Murphy.(89mins).

videos.description: The grumpy ogre returns as Shrek deals with impending fatherhood and the call to be King of Far Far Away. Star-studded animated sequel.

videos.description: The story of a magical theme park where the imagination of a little girl named June comes to life. Animated family film with the voices of Mila Kunis and Jennifer Garner.

videos.description: Over the course of several lifetimes a loveable dog tries to figure out what it means to be man's best friend. Family drama with Dennis Quaid.

videos.title: The Secret Life Of Pets 2
videos.description: Sequel to the hit film about the adventures of our pets that we don't see when we leave home. With the voices of Kevin Hart and Harrison Ford.

videos.description: In the synthetic town of Thneedville, a besotted boy takes up a quest to find the last real tree on earth. Animation with the voice of Danny DeVito.
